connections_SortConnection.description:
Specifies the sort order for results. By default sorting direction is ascending. To have the results sorted in descending order add the - prefix.

That is:
  • connection_name: sorts the result by the connection_name field in ascending order.
  • -connection_name: sorts the result by the connection_name field in descending order.

If not given, results are sorted by created_at in descending order.
connections_SortConnection.name: sort

ConnectionJitterBuffer.description: Configuration options for Jitter Buffer. Enables Jitter Buffer for RTP streams of SIP Trunking calls. The feature is off unless enabled. You may define min and max values in msec for customized buffering behaviors. Larger values add latency but tolerate more jitter, while smaller values reduce latency but are more sensitive to jitter and reordering.

enable_jitter_buffer.description: Enables Jitter Buffer for RTP streams of SIP Trunking calls. The feature is off unless enabled.

jitterbuffer_msec_max.description: The maximum jitter buffer size in milliseconds. Must be between 40 and 400. Has no effect if enable_jitter_buffer is not true.

jitterbuffer_msec_min.description: The minimum jitter buffer size in milliseconds. Must be between 40 and 400. Has no effect if enable_jitter_buffer is not true.

ConnectionNoiseSuppression.description: Controls when noise suppression is applied to calls. When set to 'inbound', noise suppression is applied to incoming audio. When set to 'outbound', it's applied to outgoing audio. When set to 'both', it's applied in both directions. When set to 'disabled', noise suppression is turned off.

ConnectionNoiseSuppressionDetails.description: Configuration options for noise suppression. These settings are stored regardless of the noise_suppression value, but only take effect when noise_suppression is not 'disabled'. If you disable noise suppression and later re-enable it, the previously configured settings will be used.

attenuation_limit.description: The attenuation limit value for the selected engine. Default values vary by engine: 0 for 'denoiser', 80 for 'deep_filter_net', 'deep_filter_net_large', and all Krisp engines ('krisp_viva_tel', 'krisp_viva_tel_lite', 'krisp_viva_promodel', 'krisp_viva_ss'), 100 for 'quail_voice_focus'.

engine.description: The noise suppression engine to use. 'denoiser' is the default engine. 'deep_filter_net' and 'deep_filter_net_large' are alternative engines with different performance characteristics. Krisp engines ('krisp_viva_tel', 'krisp_viva_tel_lite', 'krisp_viva_promodel', 'krisp_viva_ss') provide advanced noise suppression capabilities. 'quail_voice_focus' provides Quail-based voice focus noise suppression.

capture_enabled.description: Enable the capture and storage of RTCP messages to create QoS reports on the Telnyx Mission Control Portal.

port.description: RTCP port by default is rtp+1, it can also be set to rtcp-mux

report_frequency_secs.description: RTCP reports are sent to customers based on the frequency set. Frequency is in seconds and it can be set to values from 5 to 3000 seconds.

ani_number_format.description: This setting allows you to set the format with which the caller's number (ANI) is sent for inbound phone calls.

channel_limit.description: When set, this will limit the total number of inbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.

codecs.description: Defines the list of codecs that Telnyx will send for inbound calls to a specific number on your portal account, in priority order. This only works when the Connection the number is assigned to uses Media Handling mode: default. OPUS and H.264 codecs are available only when using TCP or TLS transport for SIP.

default_routing_method.description: Default routing method to be used when a number is associated with the connection. Must be one of the routing method types or left blank, other values are not allowed.

generate_ringback_tone.description: Generate ringback tone through 183 session progress message with early media.

isup_headers_enabled.description: When set, inbound phone calls will receive ISUP parameters via SIP headers. (Only when available and only when using TCP or TLS transport.)

prack_enabled.description: Enable PRACK messages as defined in RFC3262.

shaken_stir_enabled.description: When enabled the SIP Connection will receive the Identity header with Shaken/Stir data in the SIP INVITE message of inbound calls, even when using UDP transport.

sip_region.description: Selects which `sip_region` to receive inbound calls from. If null, the default region (US) will be used.

sip_subdomain.description: Specifies a subdomain that can be used to receive Inbound calls to a Connection, in the same way a phone number is used, from a SIP endpoint. Example: the subdomain "example.sip.telnyx.com" can be called from any SIP endpoint by using the SIP URI "sip:@example.sip.telnyx.com" where the user part can be any alphanumeric value. TLS signaling is supported. SRTP media encryption requires TLS transport.

sip_subdomain_receive_settings.description: This option can be enabled to receive calls from: "Anyone" (any SIP endpoint in the public Internet) or "Only my connections" (any connection assigned to the same Telnyx user).

timeout_1xx_secs.description: Time(sec) before aborting if connection is not made.

timeout_2xx_secs.description: Time(sec) before aborting if call is unanswered (min: 1, max: 600).

bridge_generate_comfort_noise_on_cn.description: Stores the connection preference for generating silent RTP toward the opposite call leg when comfort-noise packets (CN, payload type 13) are received during hold. Optional; defaults to false when omitted on creation. Only JSON true and false are accepted; null and non-boolean values are rejected. This preference is independent of default_on_hold_comfort_noise_enabled and does not modify that setting. This API provisions the preference; call-processing behavior is implemented separately.

call_cost_in_webhooks.description: Specifies if call cost webhooks should be sent for this connection.

default_on_hold_comfort_noise_enabled.description: When enabled, Telnyx will generate comfort noise when you place the call on hold. If disabled, you will need to generate comfort noise or on hold music to avoid RTP timeout.

encode_contact_header_enabled.description: Encode the SIP contact header sent by Telnyx to avoid issues for NAT or ALG scenarios.

onnet_t38_passthrough_enabled.description: Enable on-net T38 if you prefer the sender and receiver negotiating T38 directly if both are on the Telnyx network. If this is disabled, Telnyx will be able to use T38 on just one leg of the call depending on each leg's settings.

By default, Telnyx will send the re-invite. If set to `customer`, the caller is expected to send the t.38 reinvite.
